note: Balanced equations over data/species.json: one that does not balance in every element and in charge fails the build. kinetics (GAME_SPEC §7): law first_order: rate = prefactor * exp(-activation / RT) * amount of `in` * affinity factor; prefactor in 1/s, activation_kj in kJ/mol. law equilibrium: fast against the step, so each step takes it to its equilibrium in every cell (GAME_SPEC §8). A reaction without kinetics does not run on its own. Sources: docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.
